Interface LocatorSpec

public sealed interface LocatorSpec
A locator route whose locator reads the body of the request, declared with HttpRouteScope.locator(String): the body stage, like HttpRouteSpec.body(Argument), HttpRouteSpec.body() and HttpRouteSpec.form() of a route, followed by the locator, see LocatorBodySpec. 
routes.locator("/accounts/{id}")
    .form()
    .locate((request, pathVariables, form) -> new AccountResource(form.getString("token")), AccountResource::routes);

The locator reads a copy of the body: the located route reads the body again, with its own body stage, @Body argument or form. The form of a copy is the one form of the request, which the located route receives too, without parsing it again. Since the body is read twice, it is held to micronaut.server.max-request-buffer-size as a whole, with 413 for a larger body. What the locator's read left open is released when its target is located.

Otherwise the locator route is a locator route of HttpRouteScope.locateAsync(String, AsyncLocatorHandler, java.util.function.Function): the target is located once per request, and the request is matched again once it is. A request the client abandons while its body is read stops waiting for the locator.

    • body

      LocatorBodySpec<AsyncRequestBody> body()
      The locator reads the body itself, as an AsyncRequestBody: a copy of the body of the request, which the locator may read once, before or while its stage completes. What its read left open is released when the stage completes, except a form it started to read: the form of a copy is the one form of the request, which the request keeps reading and releases, and the route waits for it, as it waits for a form one of its arguments reads.
      Returns:
      The locator stage

    • form

      LocatorBodySpec<FormData> form()
      The locator receives the whole submitted form, application/x-www-form-urlencoded or multipart/form-data, as FormData, like a handler of HttpRouteSpec.form(). The located route that reads the form receives the same form.

      The form is read from a copy of the body: the server must decode a form from a split of the bytes of the request, see FormCapableHttpRequest.getRawFormFields(io.micronaut.http.body.ByteBody), as the Netty server does. On a server that does not, a form request under the locator fails.

      The locator route still matches every request under its prefix: a request whose content type is not a form, e.g. a GET, a HEAD, a CORS preflight or a JSON body for a located route, is located with the empty form, like a JAX-RS @FormParam without a form entity, and its body is neither read nor buffered: the located routes decide what they consume. A form that fails to read, e.g. a malformed or too large multipart body, fails the request; it does not become empty.

      Returns:
      The locator stage
